The ONLY source is one fixed vertical cold silver-blue shaft through a small ceiling opening directly above the CENTER OF THE SUNKEN SQUARE. Do not brighten the set merely to explain the geography.

Never evenly expose the whole face or body. A turn can take that fragment back into black. Highlights belong to fixed world-space light, not the lens; no permanent eye catchlight, luminous eyes or light that tracks a face. Keep masks and skin unchanged.
